lines.t:
An automatic support {{effect}} that works in a
<c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c>'s favor.
Mostly applied by allied <c:ffff00>actions<c> of the <c:ffff00>Support skill<c>.
A {{medabot}} can hold up to 6 types; beyond that the
oldest vanish. They last a set time or number of
<c:ffff00>acts<c>; some end under specific conditions.
{{stacking|cap}} the same {{positive_effect}} resets its duration
or count; some are strengthened.
